info.title: Binacle.Net API v3
info.description:
Binacle.Net is an API created to address the 3D Bin Packing Problem in real time.





[View on Github](https://github.com/binacle-labs/Binacle.Net)

[🐳 Binacle.Net on Dockerhub](https://hub.docker.com/r/binacle/binacle-net)

get.description: Lists the presets present in configuration.
